messages.0: Are you the one they call %g@%w?^You look really weird for %rDarunia's kid.%w&Are you adopted?
messages.1: Thank Hylia! I was so worried about&when my teacher would let me get&out of detention.^I gotta go home and see my parents.
messages.2: How long has it been, do you know?^%r[[days]]%w days!?^Oh no, and it's %r[[byte:1F]]%w?&I have to check on my cake!!
messages.3: [[byte:12]][[byte:39]][[byte:C7]]You fell into my %rtrap!%w&Foolish boy, it was me, Ganondorf!!!^...whoa, where am I?&What happened?^Weird.
messages.4: Thanks, but I don't know if I wanna go&just yet...^Hmm...^...^...^...^...^...maybe I can come back later.&Bye bye.
messages.5: Do you know about %b[[byte:9F]]%w?&It's this weird symbol that's been&in my dreams lately...^Apparently, you pressed it %b[[a_btn]]%w times.^Wow.
messages.6: [[byte:13]][[byte:1A]]Boy, you must be hot!&Get yourself a bottle of&%rLon Lon Milk%w right away and cool&down, for only %g30%w rupees!
messages.7: In that case, I'll help you out!^They say that %rthe thing you're&looking for%w can only be found%g when&you're not looking for it.%w^Hope that helps!
messages.8: I dunno why I was thrown in here,&truth be told.&I'm just a %g"PR"%w person.
messages.9: Hey! Somebody finally stopped!^All the others ran right past me.&Something about %r"wasting time"%w...^I'm telling everyone back home!&...They won't believe me.
messages.10: You came all this way just to&talk to me?^Nobody does that unless I've got&%rsomething they want%w...^...Hey, why are you looking&at my pockets?

messages.0: %cMissing a small key in a dungeon?&Maybe the %rboss %chas it!
messages.1: %cSometimes you can use the %rMegaton&Hammer %cinstead of bombs!
messages.2: %cStuck on this seed? You could &throw in the towel and check the&%wspoiler log%c...
messages.3: %cDid you know that the %yHover&Boots %ccan be used to cross&%wquicksand%c?
messages.4: %cYou can reach the back of %wImpa's&House %cby jumping from the&unfinished house with a %rcucco%c!
messages.5: %cThe %ySpirit Trial %cin %pGanon's Castle&%chas a %whidden chest %csomewhere.&Did you already know that?
messages.6: %cYou know the %wBombchu Bowling&Alley%c? I heard %wonly two of the &prizes %care worthwhile. The rest &is junk!
messages.7: %cHave you been using %wDeku Nuts&%cenough? I've seen them blow up&a %rBombchu%c!
messages.8: %cYou might end up with an %wextra&key %cfor the %bWater Temple %cor the&%rFire Temple%c. It's for your safety!
messages.9: %cIf you can't pick up a %rbomb&flower %cwith your hands, you can&still detonate it with %rfire %cor&with %warrows%c!
messages.10: %cEven an adult can't push large&blocks without some %wextra&strength%c!
messages.11: %cI've heard that %rFlare Dancer&%cis weak to the %wMaster Sword%c!&Have you tried it?
messages.12: %cDon't have a weapon to kill a&%rspider%c? Try throwing a %wpot&%cat it!
messages.13: %cI hear the patch of %wsoft soil&%cin %bZora's River %cis the only one&that isn't home to a %rspider%c!
messages.14: %cThe people of Hyrule sometimes&have %witems %cfor you, but they won't&like it if you're %wwearing a mask%c!
messages.15: %cIf you get trapped somewhere, you&might have to %wsave your game %cand&%wreset%c!
messages.16: %cSheik will meet you in a %rburning&village %conce you have %gForest%c,&%rFire%c, and %bWater %cMedallions!
messages.17: %cIf you don't have a %wsword %cas a&child, try buying %wDeku Sticks%c!&They're effective against your foes!
